Canonical site: https://jeonkwan.github.io/kinetic-construct/
Source repository: https://github.com/Jeonkwan/kinetic-construct

Consolidated collected sources for generating compatible technical guides.
Known source gap: the architecture specimen introduces three planes but supplies no enumeration. Its four recovered architectural laws are included below.
For guides in other projects, use the absolute hosted asset URLs below. The bundled starter retains relative paths for use inside the downloaded repository; replace them with these hosted URLs when copying the starter alone.

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://jeonkwan.github.io/kinetic-construct/css/kinetic-serif.css" />
<script src="https://jeonkwan.github.io/kinetic-construct/js/kinetic-serif.js" defer></script>
```

## Authoring guide
Source: https://jeonkwan.github.io/kinetic-construct/reference/guide.md

<!-- BEGIN reference/guide.md -->
# Kinetic Construct (kinetic-serif v1.2.3) Authoring Guide

[Living design system](https://jeonkwan.github.io/kinetic-construct/) · [CSS](https://jeonkwan.github.io/kinetic-construct/css/kinetic-serif.css) · [Runtime](https://jeonkwan.github.io/kinetic-construct/js/kinetic-serif.js) · [JSON tokens](https://jeonkwan.github.io/kinetic-construct/reference/kinetic-serif.json)

## Philosophy & Communication Principles

1. **Information First**: Structure the explanation before selecting its visual presentation. Architecture diagrams must clarify dependencies, trust perimeters, and failure modes—not demonstrate rendering technology.
2. **Strict Semantic 3-Role Accents (Botanical Field)**:
   - **Indigo (`#3730A3`)**: Blueprint, module source, definition, contract schema.
   - **Forest Moss (`#15803D`)**: Runtime boundary, deployed root, active service, pipeline execution.
   - **Burnt Sienna (`#9A3412`)**: State storage, persistent ledger, database backend, immutable log.
   *Rule: Never use these three colors for arbitrary decoration.*
3. **Glare-Free Surfaces**:
   - Use `--bg-canvas: #F4F0E6` for viewport backdrops.
   - Use `--bg-surface: #FAF7F0` for elevated content cards.
   - Use `--bg-well: #EAE4D7` for recessed wells, code backgrounds, and callouts.
   - Pure `#FFFFFF` is prohibited to prevent high-contrast glare on OLED and laptop screens.
4. **Locked Typography Contract**:
   - Display Headings: `Fraunces, Georgia, serif` (Weights 700-800, line-height 1.15-1.22).
   - Reading Prose: `Bitter, Georgia, serif` at `15px` (`0.9375rem`), line-height `1.55`, constrained to `max-width: 65ch`.
   - Technical & Code: `Fira Code, monospace` at `13px` (`0.8125rem`), line-height `1.55`.
   - Badges & Eyebrows: Strict floor of `13px` (`0.8125rem`). Never use sub-12px micro-text.
5. **Spatial Density & Layout**:
   - Navigation: Compact `220px` sticky left rail (`sidebar-rail`) that collapses into horizontal pills on mobile viewports.
   - Flush Cards: Do not wrap sections in redundant outer container boxes with compound nested padding.
   - Side-Docked Workbench: On viewports >= 960px, dock topology graphs side-by-side with code/contract inspectors (`1.25fr 1fr`).
   - Tactile Chrome: `2px solid #111111` borders with `2px 2px 0px #111111` shadows. Interactive elements depress by `(1px, 1px)` on `:active`.
<!-- END reference/guide.md -->

## Agent skill
Source: https://jeonkwan.github.io/kinetic-construct/reference/SKILL.md

<!-- BEGIN reference/SKILL.md -->
---
name: kinetic-serif
description: Design and build technical explainers, interactive architecture guides, system documentation, and web pages using the Kinetic Construct (kinetic-serif v1.2.3) design system. Use whenever the user asks to use kinetic-serif or Kinetic Construct, wants modern high-contrast editorial typography (Fraunces + Bitter + Fira Code), or needs compact technical documentation with Warm Alabaster surfaces, Botanical Field semantic accents, crisp 2px tactile shadows, and Alabaster Book code blocks.
---
# Kinetic Construct (kinetic-serif v1.2.3)

Create high-density, legible technical explainers and living architecture documentation using the calibrated Kinetic Construct design language.

## When to Use

- The user requests an interactive architecture explainer, technical guide, system topology, or living design system in `kinetic-serif` or **Kinetic Construct**.
- Building technical documentation where clarity, information density, and screen efficiency (13"-14" laptops and mobile devices) are prioritized.
- Presenting complex cloud infrastructure, pipelines, API choreography, or decision matrices.

## Hosted References & Integration

Canonical site: [Kinetic Construct](https://jeonkwan.github.io/kinetic-construct/).

When authoring a guide in another project, use the published assets:

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://jeonkwan.github.io/kinetic-construct/css/kinetic-serif.css" />
<script src="https://jeonkwan.github.io/kinetic-construct/js/kinetic-serif.js" defer></script>
```

The stylesheet imports Fraunces, Bitter, and Fira Code and defines the complete light/dark token contract. Read the [authoring guide](https://jeonkwan.github.io/kinetic-construct/reference/guide.md) for layout and semantic color rules and the [JSON tokens](https://jeonkwan.github.io/kinetic-construct/reference/kinetic-serif.json) for machine-readable values. Use the [starter HTML](https://jeonkwan.github.io/kinetic-construct/starter/index.html) as a structural example; when copying it to another project, replace its `../css/` and `../js/` references with the hosted URLs above, or copy those asset directories and adjust the paths to their local location.

- [Discovery manifest](https://jeonkwan.github.io/kinetic-construct/llms.txt): discover the published resources.
- [Complete prompt context](https://jeonkwan.github.io/kinetic-construct/llms-full.txt): ingest the consolidated guide, tokens, assets, starter, and specimen.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/Jeonkwan/kinetic-construct): inspect or download the maintained sources.

For offline use, bundle the CSS and JavaScript with the guide and provide the fonts locally if they are needed without internet access. The Pages URLs track the repository's latest deployed `main`; vendor assets from a chosen Git commit when a project needs a fixed revision.

## Core Design Contract & CSS Tokens

The hosted stylesheet includes the complete token set. The excerpt below records the core design values for reference and inline implementations:

```css
:root {
  --bg-canvas: #F4F0E6;       /* Warm Alabaster canvas */
  --bg-surface: #FAF7F0;      /* Elevated card surface */
  --bg-well: #EAE4D7;         /* Recessed code well */
  --ink-primary: #111111;     /* Primary chrome & heading ink */
  --ink-prose: #222222;       /* Body prose ink */
  --ink-muted: #4A4740;       /* Secondary captions */

  --accent-module: #3730A3;   /* Indigo: Blueprint / Module */
  --accent-module-bg: #E0E7FF;
  --accent-root: #15803D;     /* Forest Moss: Runtime Root */
  --accent-root-bg: #DCFCE7;
  --accent-state: #9A3412;    /* Burnt Sienna: State Ledger */
  --accent-state-bg: #FFEDD5;

  --border-thick: 2px solid var(--ink-primary);
  --shadow-tactile: 2px 2px 0px var(--ink-primary);
  --radius-subtle: 6px;

  --font-display: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif;
  --font-prose: 'Bitter', Georgia, serif;       /* 15px / 0.9375rem */
  --font-mono: 'Fira Code', monospace;         /* 13px / 0.8125rem */

  --container-max: 1520px;
  --rail-width: 220px;
  --outer-gutter: clamp(12px, 1.8vw, 24px);
  --section-gap: 22px;
}
```
<!-- END reference/SKILL.md -->

/* ==========================================================================
   KINETIC CONSTRUCT (kinetic-serif v1.2.3)
   Core Design System Tokens, Typography Floors & Component Primitives
   ========================================================================== */

@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bitter:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;1,400&family=Fira+Code:wght@400;500;600&family=Fraunces:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..144,700..800;1,9..144,700&display=swap');

:root {
  /* Glare-Free Paper Surfaces & Ink (Warm Alabaster Default) */
  --bg-canvas: #F4F0E6;
  --bg-surface: #FAF7F0;
  --bg-well: #EAE4D7;
  --ink-primary: #111111;
  --ink-prose: #222222;
  --ink-muted: #4A4740;

  /* Botanical Field 3-Role Architecture Accents */
  --accent-module: #3730A3;
  --accent-module-bg: #E0E7FF;
  --accent-root: #15803D;
  --accent-root-bg: #DCFCE7;
  --accent-state: #9A3412;
  --accent-state-bg: #FFEDD5;

  --border-thick: 2px solid var(--ink-primary);
  --border-hairline: 1px solid var(--ink-primary);
  --shadow-tactile: 2px 2px 0px var(--ink-primary);
  --shadow-tactile-hover: 4px 4px 0px var(--ink-primary);
  --shadow-tactile-active: 1px 1px 0px var(--ink-primary);
  --radius-subtle: 6px;

  --font-display: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif;
  --font-prose: 'Bitter', Georgia, serif;
  --font-mono: 'Fira Code', monospace;

  /* Spatial & Density Specifications (Compact & Flush) */
  --container-max: 1520px;
  --rail-width: 220px;
  --outer-gutter: clamp(12px, 1.8vw, 24px);
  --section-gap: 22px;

## Runtime
Source: https://jeonkwan.github.io/kinetic-construct/js/kinetic-serif.js

<!-- BEGIN js/kinetic-serif.js -->
/**
 * Kinetic Construct (kinetic-serif v1.2.3) Runtime
 * Manages theme toggling, node graph inspection, copy helpers,
 * and client-side zero-dependency ZIP archive creation.
 */

(function () {
  'use strict';

  const assetBase = new URL('../', document.currentScript.src);

  // 1. Theme Toggle
  window.toggleTheme = function () {
    const html = document.documentElement;
    const next = html.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';
    html.setAttribute('data-theme', next);
    try { localStorage.setItem('kinetic-theme', next); } catch (_) { /* Storage may be disabled. */ }
    const btn = document.getElementById('themeToggleBtn');
    if (btn) btn.textContent = next === 'dark' ? '☀️ Daylight' : '🌙 Nocturnal';
  };

  let saved;
  try { saved = localStorage.getItem('kinetic-theme'); } catch (_) { /* Use the system preference. */ }
  if (saved) {
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', saved);
  } else if (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches) {
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark');
  }

  const themeButton = document.getElementById('themeToggleBtn');
  if (themeButton) {
    themeButton.textContent = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark'
      ? '☀️ Daylight' : '🌙 Nocturnal';
  }

  // 2. Clipboard Copy Helper
  window.copySnippet = function (btn, textToCopy) {
    const text = textToCopy || btn.closest('.code-wrapper').querySelector('.code-lines-col').innerText;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => {
      const orig = btn.innerText;
      btn.innerText = 'Copied! ✓';
      setTimeout(() => { btn.innerText = orig; }, 1800);
    });
  };

  // 3. Topology Inspector Handler
  window.selectTopologyNode = function (btn, role, title, file, code, blastDesc) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.node-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('selected'));
    btn.classList.add('selected');

    const badge = document.getElementById('topologyInspBadge');
    if (badge) {
      badge.className = `role-badge ${role}`;
      badge.textContent = role === 'module' ? 'MODULE BLUEPRINT' : role === 'root' ? 'EXECUTION ROOT' : 'REMOTE STATE LEDGER';
    }

    const titleEl = document.getElementById('topologyInspTitle');
    if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = title;

    const fileEl = document.getElementById('topologyInspFile');
    if (fileEl) fileEl.textContent = file;

    const codeEl = document.getElementById('topologyInspCode');
    if (codeEl) codeEl.textContent = code;

    const blastEl = document.getElementById('topologyInspBlast');
    if (blastEl) blastEl.textContent = blastDesc;
  };

  // 4. Decision Lab Engine
  window.calculateTopologyRecommendation = function () {
    const teamSize = document.getElementById('labTeamSize')?.value || 'small';
    const blastRisk = document.getElementById('labBlastRisk')?.value || 'standard';
    const resultCard = document.getElementById('labResultCard');
    if (!resultCard) return;

    if (teamSize === 'large' || blastRisk === 'strict') {
      resultCard.innerHTML = `
        <div class="role-badge state" style="margin-bottom: 8px;">RECOMMENDED ARCHITECTURE</div>
        <h3>Isolated Roots with Granular GCS State Boundaries</h3>
        <p>Deploy independent root configurations per service and environment with dedicated service accounts and separate state buckets to minimize blast radius.</p>
      `;
    } else {
      resultCard.innerHTML = `
        <div class="role-badge root" style="margin-bottom: 8px;">RECOMMENDED ARCHITECTURE</div>
        <h3>Lightweight Monorepo with Shared Modules</h3>
        <p>Maintain root configurations in a monorepo versioned by Git commit SHAs, referencing internal modules directly with change detection.</p>
      `;
    }
  };

  // 5. Zero-Dependency In-Browser ZIP Builder
  // Implements standard PKZip format using pure typed arrays
  function crc32(bytes) {
    let crc = 0xFFFFFFFF;
    for (const byte of bytes) {
      crc ^= byte;
      for (let bit = 0; bit < 8; bit++) {
        crc = (crc >>> 1) ^ ((crc & 1) ? 0xEDB88320 : 0);
      }
    }
    return (crc ^ 0xFFFFFFFF) >>> 0;
  }

  function createZip(files) {
    const fileEntries = [];
    let offset = 0;

    const encoder = new TextEncoder();

    files.forEach(file => {
      const nameBytes = encoder.encode(file.name);
      const dataBytes = typeof file.content === 'string' ? encoder.encode(file.content) : file.content;
      const size = dataBytes.length;
      const checksum = crc32(dataBytes);

      // Local File Header (30 bytes) + Name + Data
      const header = new Uint8Array(30 + nameBytes.length);
      const view = new DataView(header.buffer);
      view.setUint32(0, 0x04034b50, true);  // Local file header signature
      view.setUint16(4, 20, true);          // Version needed
      view.setUint16(6, 0x0800, true);      // UTF-8 filenames
      view.setUint16(8, 0, true);           // Compression: 0 (Store)
      view.setUint16(10, 0, true);          // Time
      view.setUint16(12, 33, true);         // Date: 1980-01-01
      view.setUint32(14, checksum, true);   // CRC32
      view.setUint32(18, size, true);       // Compressed size
      view.setUint32(22, size, true);       // Uncompressed size
      view.setUint16(26, nameBytes.length, true); // Name length
      view.setUint16(28, 0, true);          // Extra field length
      header.set(nameBytes, 30);

      fileEntries.push({
        nameBytes,
        header,
        dataBytes,
        offset,
        size,
        checksum
      });

      offset += header.length + dataBytes.length;
    });

    // Central Directory
    let centralDirSize = 0;
    const centralEntries = fileEntries.map(entry => {
      const cd = new Uint8Array(46 + entry.nameBytes.length);
      const view = new DataView(cd.buffer);
      view.setUint32(0, 0x02014b50, true);  // Central dir signature
      view.setUint16(4, 20, true);          // Made by
      view.setUint16(6, 20, true);          // Version needed
      view.setUint16(8, 0x0800, true);      // UTF-8 filenames
      view.setUint16(10, 0, true);          // Compression (Store)
      view.setUint16(12, 0, true);          // Time
      view.setUint16(14, 33, true);         // Date: 1980-01-01
      view.setUint32(16, entry.checksum, true); // CRC32
      view.setUint32(20, entry.size, true); // Compressed size
      view.setUint32(24, entry.size, true); // Uncompressed size
      view.setUint16(28, entry.nameBytes.length, true);
      view.setUint16(30, 0, true);          // Extra length
      view.setUint16(32, 0, true);          // Comment length
      view.setUint16(34, 0, true);          // Disk start
      view.setUint16(36, 0, true);          // Internal attrs
      view.setUint32(38, 0, true);          // External attrs
      view.setUint32(42, entry.offset, true);// Local header offset
      cd.set(entry.nameBytes, 46);
      centralDirSize += cd.length;
      return cd;
    });

    // End of Central Directory Record (22 bytes)
    const eocd = new Uint8Array(22);
    const eocdView = new DataView(eocd.buffer);
    eocdView.setUint32(0, 0x06054b50, true);  // EOCD signature
    eocdView.setUint16(4, 0, true);           // Disk number
    eocdView.setUint16(6, 0, true);           // Central dir disk
    eocdView.setUint16(8, fileEntries.length, true);  // Disk entries
    eocdView.setUint16(10, fileEntries.length, true); // Total entries
    eocdView.setUint32(12, centralDirSize, true);     // Central dir size
    eocdView.setUint32(16, offset, true);             // Central dir offset
    eocdView.setUint16(20, 0, true);                  // Comment length

    // Assemble parts into single Blob
    const parts = [];
    fileEntries.forEach(e => {
      parts.push(e.header);
      parts.push(e.dataBytes);
    });
    centralEntries.forEach(cd => parts.push(cd));
    parts.push(eocd);

    return new Blob(parts, { type: 'application/zip' });
  }

  // 6. Download Hub Trigger
  // Pages builds a complete archive because its artifact excludes hidden files.
  // On a local HTTP server, fall back to assembling all source files in-browser.
  const repositoryFiles = [
    '.github/workflows/pages.yml', '.gitignore',
    'css/kinetic-serif.css', 'js/kinetic-serif.js',
    'reference/kinetic-serif.json', 'reference/SKILL.md',
    'reference/guide.md', 'reference/architecture-spec.md',
    'starter/index.html', 'index.html', 'llms.txt', 'llms-full.txt',
    'README.md', 'LICENSE', 'make_repo.py'
  ];

  window.downloadRepoZip = async function (btn) {
    const origText = btn.innerHTML;
    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.innerHTML = 'Compiling ZIP... ⏳';

    try {
      const archiveName = 'kinetic-construct-v1.2.3.zip';
      const response = await fetch(new URL(archiveName, assetBase));
      let blob;
      if (response.ok) {
        blob = await response.blob();
      } else {
        const files = await Promise.all(repositoryFiles.map(async path => {
          const result = await fetch(new URL(path, assetBase));
          if (!result.ok) throw new Error(`Could not fetch ${path}: HTTP ${result.status}`);
          return { name: `kinetic-construct/${path}`, content: await result.text() };
        }));
        blob = createZip(files);
      }

      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = archiveName;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      a.remove();
      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);

      btn.innerHTML = 'Downloaded! ✓';
      setTimeout(() => { btn.innerHTML = origText; }, 2200);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      alert('Unable to download the complete repository. Serve this folder over HTTP, or run python3 make_repo.py to create the ZIP locally.');
      btn.innerHTML = origText;
    } finally {
      btn.disabled = false;
    }
  };

  // 7. Rail Scroll Sync
  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    const sections = document.querySelectorAll('section[id]');
    const scrollPos = window.scrollY + 120;
    sections.forEach(sec => {
      const top = sec.offsetTop;
      const height = sec.offsetHeight;
      const id = sec.getAttribute('id');
      if (scrollPos >= top && scrollPos < top + height) {
        document.querySelectorAll('.rail-link').forEach(link => {
          link.classList.toggle('active', link.getAttribute('href') === `#${id}`);
        });
      }
    });
  });
})();
<!-- END js/kinetic-serif.js -->

## Architecture specimen
Source: https://jeonkwan.github.io/kinetic-construct/reference/architecture-spec.md

<!-- BEGIN reference/architecture-spec.md -->
# Reference Architecture Specimen: GCP Terraform Monorepo & State Isolation

## Conceptual Model

Infrastructure as Code architecture separates into three orthogonal planes:

## Architectural Laws

1. **State Isolation over Folder Hierarchy**: State isolation is determined solely by backend prefix and bucket IAM permissions—never by folder nesting alone.
2. **Deterministic Version Promotion**: Roots deploy against explicit Git commit SHAs, never floating branch heads or mutable tags.
3. **Least Privilege Blast Perimeter**: Every root operates with a dedicated Google Service Account possessing permissions strictly bounded to that root's resources.
4. **Independent GCS State Locks**: Each root locks its own independent state object, preventing multi-service lock contention.
<!-- END reference/architecture-spec.md -->
